1 . 
Affidavit of service filed be taken on record.

2. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 states that after filing of the final report by the Police,
the opposite party no.2 filed a Naraji petition which as per instruction has since been allowed and the matter is pending further investigation with the Police.
3. Learned counsel for the State fairly submits that an appropriate order may be passed.
4. Taking into account facts and circumstances, the investigating officer is directed to conduct the investigation expeditiously and file report.

Learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Hooghly is also requested to ensure expeditious disposal of GR Case No.1340 of 2022 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, Chinsurah Police Station, in accordance with law.
